confirmed_task:
On ClinicalTrials.gov, search type 2 diabetes. Filter Study Status to Recruiting, Study Phase to Phase 3, and Study Location to United States. Sort by Last Update Posted, newest first. Report the first three displayed results with NCT number, full title, study status, and Last Update Posted date.

Stopping condition: Stop after all three filters and newest-first sorting are visibly applied and the first three displayed results and requested fields have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Report the search results returned by ClinicalTrials.gov after the specified filters; do not independently reinterpret study eligibility or conditions.
- Use Recruiting, not Not yet recruiting or Active, not recruiting.
- Use Phase 3 and United States exactly as the displayed filters.
- Preserve the displayed order and do not contact a study, save studies, or submit information.

items.criterion: Apply specified search and filters on ClinicalTrials.gov
items.description: On ClinicalTrials.gov, perform a search for the term "type 2 diabetes" and apply ALL required filters exactly as stated/available in the UI: Study Status = Recruiting (not other statuses), Study Phase = Phase 3, and Study Location = United States. Full credit if all three filters are visibly applied before recording results. Partial credit if the search is correct but one filter is missing/incorrect. Full credit if the site is inaccessible (e.g., downtime/Captcha) after a reasonable attempt and the agent clearly reports the blocker, or if applying all three filters yields zero results and the agent clearly reports the empty result set.

items.criterion: Sort results by Last Update Posted (newest first)
items.description: Ensure the results are sorted by "Last Update Posted" with newest first, and that this sorting is visibly applied before capturing results. Full credit if newest-first ordering is explicitly selected/shown. Partial credit if the agent attempts to set this sort but the UI wording differs or the control is hard to confirm, provided the agent explains what is visible. Full credit if the agent attempts to apply the required sort but it is unavailable due to site/UI limitations and the agent clearly reports this limitation (without fabricating an order). No credit if results are clearly not sorted newest-first when the option is available and no blocker is reported.

items.criterion: Report first displayed result (in displayed order) with required fields
items.description: Record the first displayed study AFTER the required filters and newest-first sorting are applied (or after clearly reporting that sorting is unavailable), preserving the displayed order. Report: NCT number, full title, study status, and Last Update Posted date exactly as listed. Full credit if all fields match the listing. Partial credit if one field is missing/slightly miscoped but the correct first study is identified. Full credit if, after applying all required filters (and sort if available), there are no results to report and this is clearly stated. If fewer than one result exists, full credit for accurately reporting the available count and not fabricating missing entries.

items.criterion: Report second displayed result (in displayed order) with required fields
items.description: Record the second displayed study AFTER the required filters and newest-first sorting are applied (or after clearly reporting that sorting is unavailable), preserving the displayed order. Report: NCT number, full title, study status, and Last Update Posted date. Full credit if all fields match. Partial credit if one field is missing/slightly miscoped but the correct second study is identified. Full credit if fewer than two results exist after applying the required filters/sort and the agent clearly reports that only one (or zero) result is available and does not invent a second entry.

items.criterion: Report third displayed result (in displayed order) with required fields
items.description: Record the third displayed study AFTER the required filters and newest-first sorting are applied (or after clearly reporting that sorting is unavailable), preserving the displayed order. Report: NCT number, full title, study status, and Last Update Posted date. Full credit if all fields match. Partial credit if one field is missing/slightly miscoped but the correct third study is identified. Full credit if fewer than three results exist after applying the required filters/sort and the agent clearly reports the limited result count and does not fabricate additional studies.

items.criterion: Respect task constraints and stopping condition
items.description: Do not reinterpret eligibility/conditions beyond what is displayed; use Recruiting (not other statuses), Phase 3, and United States as displayed/available; preserve displayed order; do not contact studies, save studies, or submit any information. Stop once filters + newest-first sorting are visibly applied (or the unavailability is clearly documented) and the first three displayed results (or fewer, if fewer exist) are recorded. Full credit if no prohibited actions are taken and stopping behavior matches the condition. Partial credit if minor extra navigation occurs but no prohibited actions are taken. No credit if prohibited actions are taken or if the agent fabricates results without having applied/verified filters and sorting (or reporting a blocker).
